about_the_game:
wander, daydream, and explore void amongst stars and creatures.

In [ VOID ], you are Mee — a small creature born into a land with no instructions, no memories, and no clear path forward.

The world bends and shifts with your touch, revealing secrets hidden not in words, but in movement, sound, and quiet moments.

Every step forward is a step inward, as the mysteries you uncover mirror the ones you carry inside.

  • No Endings, Only Journeys
    There are no fail states, and no clear finish line. [ VOID ] is a looping world where wandering is the destination — and understanding comes slowly, softly, in your own time.
    To fully immerse yourself in its rhythm, we recommend using a game controller.

Beneath the quiet soil, behind the drifting shadows,
the world hums a song meant only for you.
Not in words, not in light.
But in the spaces between.
Will you step closer to hear it?

short_description: A black-and-white 3D exploration game set in a surreal, textless world. Wander through shifting landscapes, encounter enigmatic creatures, and uncover hidden truths in a dreamlike void.
